set.body: From the p0-scaladoc review. ComparisonMethods.scala:51-57/65 always declares HigherIsCloser, and its DistanceLike arm cannot be reached by any built-in method today. A future MapSimilarityMethod declaring DistanceLike would be mislabelled. Either derive the direction from the scale or add a ComparisonMethodLaws law forbidding it.
set.title: Comparison descriptor: derive ScoreDirection from the scale (DistanceLike is LowerIsCloser) or forbid DistanceLike similarities
